doc.title.zh-CN: VoltProof —— 电路仿真实验助手

doc.title.compare.zh-CN: 同题对照 —— 直接问 AI vs VoltProof
doc.title.compare.en: Side by side — asking an AI vs VoltProof

tagline.zh-CN: 每一份回答都附带仿真证据 · ngspice 验证
tagline.en: Every answer comes with ngspice evidence

title.tip.zh-CN: 电路名称（进入对话历史与实验报告）
title.tip.en: Circuit name (used in chat history and lab reports)

demo.tip.zh-CN: 载入示例 RC 低通滤波器

demo.confirm.zh-CN: 载入示例会替换当前画布，继续？
demo.confirm.en: Loading the example replaces the canvas. Continue?

clear.confirm.zh-CN: 清空画布？此操作不可撤销。
clear.confirm.en: Clear the canvas? This cannot be undone.

ai.explain.tip.zh-CN: 用大模型解释最近一次仿真结果（不改电路）
ai.explain.tip.en: Ask the model to explain the latest simulation (it will not change the circuit)

ai.explain.running.zh-CN: AI 解读中…（只解释波形，不会修改你的电路）
ai.explain.running.en: Writing notes… (explanation only, the circuit stays as it is)

model.tip.zh-CN: 大模型设置（供应商 / API Key / 模型）

pcb.tip.zh-CN: PCB 导出（实验性）：验证过的电路 → 器件映射 → 自动布线 → DRC → 制板文件
pcb.tip.en: PCB export (experimental): verified circuit → parts → routing → DRC → fab files

preview.hint.zh-CN: 高亮部分为 AI 生成的电路，确认后替换画布（旧图可撤销找回）
preview.hint.en: Highlighted parts are the generated circuit. Apply replaces the canvas; you can undo.

props.empty.zh-CN:
点击画布上的元件进行编辑。

连线：点元件引脚（蓝点）→ 点另一引脚或导线。
快捷键：R 旋转 · Del 删除 · Esc 取消。

画完点右上角「仿真」——ngspice 实测，波形与指标都来自真实仿真。
props.empty.en:
Click a part to edit it.

Wire: click a pin (blue dot), then another pin or a wire.
Keys: R rotate · Del delete · Esc cancel.

Then press Simulate. Waveforms and metrics come from ngspice.

ex.rc.prompt.zh-CN: 设计一个截止频率1kHz的RC低通滤波器
ex.rc.prompt.en: Design an RC low-pass filter with a 1 kHz cutoff

ex.amp.prompt.zh-CN: 用理想运放设计一个增益-10倍的反相放大器，仿真验证
ex.amp.prompt.en: Design an inverting op-amp with a gain of -10 and verify it by simulation

ex.rect.prompt.zh-CN: 设计桥式整流+电容滤波电路，220V/50Hz降压到12V，纹波<1V
ex.rect.prompt.en: Design a bridge rectifier with capacitor filtering: 220 V / 50 Hz down to 12 V, ripple < 1 V

attach.tip.en: Attach a netlist or text file

whatif.btn.zh-CN: what-if 参数扫描：对当前电路改一个元件值，逐点真实仿真看趋势（非 AI 生成）
whatif.btn.en: What-if sweep: change one part and simulate each value (not AI-generated)

chat.placeholder.zh-CN: 围绕当前电路继续讨论…（Enter 发送）
chat.placeholder.en: Continue from the current circuit… (Enter to send)

chat.attachment.fallback.en: Simulate and verify the attached circuit

chat.rejected.zh-CN: 🚫 超出能力范围（已前置拒绝，未消耗生成与仿真）
chat.rejected.en: 🚫 Out of scope (rejected up front; no generation or simulation was run)

ws.help.zh-CN: 输入本地目录的绝对路径。之后所有产物（电路/波形/报告）与会话状态都只保存在该目录内，拷走文件夹即完整归档。
ws.help.en: Enter the absolute path of a local folder. Circuits, waveforms, reports, and chats stay in that folder, so copying it archives the project.

hist.empty.zh-CN: 还没有对话——发送第一条消息即创建
hist.empty.en: No chats yet — send a message to start one

hist.report.tip.zh-CN: 导出实验报告（打印即 PDF）
hist.report.tip.en: Export a lab report (print to PDF)

hist.missing.zh-CN: 对话不存在（可能已被清理）
hist.missing.en: Chat not found (it may have been removed)

llm.help.zh-CN: 任何 OpenAI 兼容供应商均可。API Key 只保存在本机 settings.json，不会回显完整内容，也不会发给除供应商以外的任何地方。
llm.help.en: Any OpenAI-compatible provider works. The API key stays in local settings.json, is never shown in full, and is sent only to that provider.

llm.keep.zh-CN: 留空的项保持不变 · Key 输入框留空 = 不修改
llm.keep.en: Blank fields stay as they are. A blank key field does not change the key.

llm.key.keepPh.zh-CN: 留空表示沿用当前 Key
llm.key.keepPh.en: Leave blank to keep the current key

llm.modelPh.zh-CN: deepseek-flash（可点右侧按钮拉取列表）

llm.fetched.zh-CN: 获取到 {n} 个模型，点选：

whatif.help.zh-CN: 对当前项目已验证的电路，把一个元件改成多个值逐点真实仿真，看波形族与指标趋势——纯确定性，非 AI 生成。
whatif.help.en: Take a verified circuit, change one part across several values, and simulate each point. Deterministic — not AI-generated.

whatif.values.zh-CN: 取值（逗号分隔，SPICE 写法，最多 12 个）

whatif.none.zh-CN: 当前电路里没有可扫描的元件（R/C/L 与直流源）
whatif.none.en: This circuit has no scannable parts (R, C, L, or a DC source)

whatif.running.zh-CN: 逐值仿真中…（每个值一次真实 ngspice 运行）
whatif.running.en: Simulating each value… (one ngspice run per value)

verdict.simulated.zh-CN: 仿真完成 · 尚未设置验收目标

verdict.legacyOk.zh-CN: 历史仿真结果 · 目标验收状态未知

window.tran.zh-CN: 按时间去除前 {pct}% 暂态

proof.cached.zh-CN: 复用历史验证结果 · 原始运行 {when}

proof.noWave.zh-CN: 该次历史结果没有交互波形数据，请重新仿真
proof.noWave.en: This saved result has no interactive waveform. Simulate again.

cmp.help.zh-CN: 选择两个版本，查看已保存指标和元件变化。候选版本也可查看；只有采用后才改变当前电路。
cmp.help.en: Pick two versions to see saved metrics and netlist changes. Candidates can be viewed; only adopting one changes the current circuit.

req.help.zh-CN: 数值使用基本单位 Hz、V、倍、%。保存后需重新仿真；自然语言中的新目标仍可更新这些条件。
req.help.en: Use base units: Hz, V, ×, %. Save, then simulate again. A new target in chat can still update these.

req.bad.zh-CN: 无法保存未识别的验收条件

req.needMetric.zh-CN: 请为每条条件选择指标
req.needMetric.en: Choose a metric for each target

req.needRef.zh-CN: 元件参数需要位号，如 R1
req.needRef.en: A part value needs a refdes, such as R1

wave.hint.zh-CN: 移动鼠标读取波形；拖动下方范围查看局部。
wave.hint.en: Move the pointer to read values. Drag the range to zoom.

project.loading.zh-CN: 项目还在载入，请稍后重试
project.loading.en: The project is still loading. Try again in a moment.

project.saveFail.zh-CN: 项目保存失败，请重新载入
project.saveFail.en: Could not save the project. Reload it.

project.loadFail.zh-CN: 项目载入失败，请重新载入
project.loadFail.en: Could not load the project. Reload the page.

status.place.zh-CN: 点击画布放置「{name}」，R 旋转，Esc 取消
status.place.en: Click the canvas to place {name}. R rotates, Esc cancels.

status.wire.zh-CN: 连线中：点击引脚/导线结束，点击空处加拐点，Esc 取消
status.wire.en: Wiring: click a pin or wire to finish, click empty space for a corner, Esc cancels.

status.okHint.zh-CN: 提示：导线共享格点即连通；交叉不想连通就错开一格。
status.okHint.en: Wires connect where they share a grid point. Offset a crossing by one square if it should not connect.

status.empty.zh-CN: 画布为空：从左侧选择元件开始画电路，或在下方让 AI 画一个电路。
status.empty.en: Empty canvas. Pick a part on the left, or describe a circuit below.

status.preview.zh-CN: 🤖 AI 电路预览中——点上方「✓ 应用到画布」替换画布，或「✗ 丢弃」保留原图（Esc = 丢弃）
status.preview.en: AI preview — Apply replaces the canvas, Discard keeps yours (Esc discards).

status.dirty.zh-CN: 画布有修改，尚未重新验证；扫描和项目解读需先仿真。
status.dirty.en: The canvas changed and has not been verified. Simulate before a sweep or project notes.

err.label.off.zh-CN: 标签「{name}」没贴在任何导线或引脚上
err.label.off.en: Label “{name}” is not on a wire or pin

err.label.bad.zh-CN: 标签「{name}」不是合法节点名（字母开头）
err.label.bad.en: Label “{name}” is not a valid node name (start with a letter)

err.label.multi.zh-CN: 同一网络贴了多个标签：{names}

err.label.dup.en: Net name “{name}” is used more than once

err.float.zh-CN: {name} 的引脚 {pin} 未连接（悬空）

err.gnd.zh-CN: 电路缺少接地（GND）——每个网络都需要到地的通路
err.gnd.en: The circuit has no ground (GND). Every net needs a path to ground.

err.src.zh-CN: 电路缺少电源（电压源或电流源）
err.src.en: The circuit has no source (voltage or current).

err.meg.zh-CN: {name}：SPICE 里大写 M 是毫，兆要写 Meg（当前：{value}）
err.meg.en: {name}: in SPICE a capital M means milli. Use Meg for mega (now: {value})

err.orphan.zh-CN: 有一条导线没有连接任何元件
err.orphan.en: A wire is not connected to any part

prop.netHint.zh-CN: 贴在导线或引脚上，给网络命名（如 in / out / vcc）——指标与波形会显示这个名字。
prop.netHint.en: Place it on a wire or pin (in, out, vcc…). Metrics and waveforms use this name.

pal.hint.zh-CN:
共享格点即连通；交叉不连就错开一格。

R 旋转 · Del 删除 · 右键取消
pal.hint.en:
Shared grid points connect. Offset a crossing by one square to leave it open.

R rotate · Del delete · right-click cancels

hint.D.zh-CN: 自动配教学模型，无需填值
hint.D.en: A teaching model is added automatically

hint.QN.zh-CN: 引脚：左=基极，上=集电极，下=发射极；自动配模型
hint.QN.en: Pins: left base, top collector, bottom emitter. Model added automatically.

hint.MN.zh-CN: 引脚：左=栅极，上=漏极，下=源极；自动配模型
hint.MN.en: Pins: left gate, top drain, bottom source. Model added automatically.

hint.OP.zh-CN: 上输入=反相端(−)，下输入=同相端(+)
hint.OP.en: Top input is inverting (−), bottom is non-inverting (+)

hint.VSIN.zh-CN: SIN(偏置 幅度 频率)，如 SIN(0 1 1k)

hint.LBL.zh-CN: 网络名：字母开头，如 in / out / vcc
hint.LBL.en: Net name starting with a letter, e.g. in / out / vcc

result.blocked.zh-CN: ✗ 还不能仿真：先修掉连线错误
result.blocked.en: ✗ Cannot simulate yet — fix the wiring first

result.stale.zh-CN: 电路已变化，请重新仿真

result.staleHint.zh-CN: 当前连线检查已通过。上次仿真结果不再对应当前画布。
result.staleHint.en: Wiring checks pass. The last simulation no longer matches this canvas.

result.chatTip.zh-CN: 项目的讨论线程都在主页：what-if 扫描、实验报告、继续追问
result.chatTip.en: Sweeps, reports, and follow-up questions live on the workbench

ai.placeholder.empty.zh-CN: 用自然语言画一个电路，如：设计一个截止频率 1kHz 的 RC 低通滤波器
ai.placeholder.empty.en: Describe a circuit, e.g. an RC low-pass with a 1 kHz cutoff

ai.placeholder.edit.zh-CN: 描述要怎么改，如：把 C1 改成 47n / 增大增益重设偏置…（基于当前画布修改）
ai.placeholder.edit.en: Describe the edit, e.g. change C1 to 47n (based on this canvas)

ai.sendTip.zh-CN: AI 生成/修改电路：LLM 出网表并经 ngspice 验证后布局到画布（预览确认）
ai.sendTip.en: The model writes a netlist, ngspice verifies it, then you preview it on the canvas

ai.undoTip.zh-CN: 撤销最近一次 AI 应用，找回之前的画布
ai.undoTip.en: Undo the last AI apply and restore the previous canvas

ai.cancelNote.zh-CN: 已请求取消，当前调用结束后停止
ai.cancelNote.en: Cancel requested. It stops after the current call.

ai.layoutFail.zh-CN: 自动落布未成功——电路与指标见下方证据卡，可重试或手动画
ai.layoutFail.en: Auto-placement failed. The evidence card still has the circuit and metrics — retry or draw it yourself.

ai.undone.zh-CN: 已撤销 AI 应用，恢复之前的电路与验收条件
ai.undone.en: Undid the AI apply and restored the previous circuit and targets

rounds.empty.zh-CN: 尚无轮次——手动仿真、让 AI 画一个电路，或在主页对话。
rounds.empty.en: Nothing yet — simulate, ask AI to draw, or chat on the workbench.

cmp.page.title.zh-CN: 同题对照：同一个问题，两种回答

cmp.page.sub.zh-CN: 左侧：直接问大模型（只得到文字） · 右侧：VoltProof（每个数字都来自 ngspice 实测）。右侧在临时工作区运行，不会替换当前项目电路。
cmp.page.sub.en: Left: ask a model and get text only. Right: VoltProof, where every number comes from ngspice. The right side uses a temporary workspace and does not replace the current project.

cmp.page.note.zh-CN: 提示：把左侧给出的电路拿到 ngspice 里跑，参数可能是编的；右侧电路经过了真实仿真，指标是算出来的。这次演示不写入当前项目；要留下电路，请回到工作台重新运行。
cmp.page.note.en: The circuit on the left may be invented. The one on the right was actually simulated. This demo does not write into the current project — run it again on the workbench if you want to keep it.

cmp.page.rightWait.zh-CN: 临时工作区仿真中，不会改当前项目…
cmp.page.rightWait.en: Simulating in a temporary workspace. The current project stays as it is…

pcb.ready.en: Tools are ready. You can generate a PCB.

pcb.notReady.zh-CN: 工具不全：预检仍可用，任务会被拒绝并给出安装指引。
pcb.notReady.en: Tools are incomplete. Preflight still works; a job is refused with setup guidance.

pcb.step1hint.zh-CN: 从项目已验证的电路出发。激励源的网络须声明为外部端子（将生成连接器）。
pcb.step1hint.en: Starts from the verified project circuit. Source nets must be declared as external ports (they become connectors).

pcb.portsHint.zh-CN: 激励源网络已自动勾选为端子；点下方网络名可增删（如输出 out）。
pcb.portsHint.en: Source nets are selected as ports. Click a net name to add or remove it (for example out).

pcb.noVer.zh-CN: 暂无候选版本——先「生成 PCB」。
pcb.noVer.en: No candidates yet — generate a PCB first.

pcb.exportTip.zh-CN: 仅当前采用的检查通过版本可导出
pcb.exportTip.en: Only the current, checked version can be exported

pcb.exportOk.zh-CN:
制板包已就绪（{n} 个文件）：
{dir}

pcb.caption.zh-CN: 版本 {id}… · {status} · 焊盘 {pads} · 走线 {tracks}（F.Cu {front} / B.Cu {back}）· 过孔 {vias} · 板框 {w}×{h}mm　（拖动元件可调整布局，然后「重布线」）
pcb.caption.en: Version {id}… · {status} · {pads} pads · {tracks} tracks (F.Cu {front} / B.Cu {back}) · {vias} vias · outline {w}×{h} mm. Drag a part, then reroute.

pcb.highlight.en: ◆ Highlighted net {net} (click empty space to clear)

pcb.rerouting.zh-CN: 按新布局重布线中（清旧走线 → 移动封装 → 布线 → 检查）…
pcb.rerouting.en: Rerouting the new placement (clear tracks → move footprints → route → check)…

api.run_busy.en: That task id is already in use

api.run_gone.en: The task has finished or does not exist

api.run_cancel.zh-CN: 已请求取消；当前模型调用返回后停止后续执行，不应用电路
api.run_cancel.en: Cancel requested. After the current model call, later steps stop and the circuit is not applied.

api.demo_note.zh-CN: 对照演示只在临时工作区运行，没有替换当前项目电路。要留下设计，请回到工作台对话重新运行。
api.demo_note.en: The comparison ran in a temporary workspace and did not replace the current project. Run it again on the workbench if you want to keep the design.

api.req_stale.zh-CN: 项目已更新，请重新打开验收条件
api.req_stale.en: The project changed. Open the targets again.

api.canvas_shape.zh-CN: 画布结构非法：需要 comps/wires/labels 三个数组
api.canvas_shape.en: Invalid canvas: comps, wires, and labels must be arrays

api.comp_coord.zh-CN: 元件坐标或旋转值非法

api.whatif_none.zh-CN: 本项目还没有验证通过的电路——先设计一个再扫描
api.whatif_none.en: This project has no verified circuit yet. Design one before sweeping.

api.whatif_none_short.zh-CN: 本项目还没有验证通过的电路
api.whatif_none_short.en: This project has no verified circuit yet

api.whatif_rev.zh-CN: 项目版本已改变，请重新打开参数扫描
api.whatif_rev.en: The project changed. Open the sweep again.

api.sim_rev.zh-CN: 项目已更新，请重新载入后仿真
api.sim_rev.en: The project changed. Reload it, then simulate.

api.llm_down_cfg.zh-CN: 大模型不可用：{msg}（可在主页 ⚙ 模型 里配置）

api.conflict_apply.zh-CN: 项目已被其他操作更新，请重新载入后再应用；当前结果已保留为候选版本
api.conflict_apply.en: The project was updated elsewhere. Reload before applying. This result is kept as a candidate.

api.conflict_dirty.zh-CN: 画布已修改，尚未重新验证。请先仿真，再运行扫描或解读
api.conflict_dirty.en: The canvas was edited and is not verified yet. Simulate before a sweep or an explanation.

api.version_missing.zh-CN: 电路版本不存在或已损坏
api.version_missing.en: Circuit version is missing or damaged

api.candidate_bad.zh-CN: 此候选版本未完成验证，不能采用
api.candidate_bad.en: This candidate was not verified, so it cannot be adopted

api.ws_abs.zh-CN: 工作区必须是绝对路径：{root}
api.ws_abs.en: The workspace must be an absolute path: {root}

api.ws_escape.zh-CN: 路径越界（必须位于工作区内）：{rel}

api.spec_array.zh-CN: 验收条件必须为数组，最多 24 项
api.spec_array.en: Targets must be an array of at most 24 items

api.spec_numeric.zh-CN: 验收目标、容差和时间窗口必须是数值
api.spec_numeric.en: Target, tolerance, and time window must be numbers

api.spec_object.en: Each target must be an object

api.spec_tol.zh-CN: 目标必须有限，相对容差必须在 0–1 之间
api.spec_tol.en: The target must be finite, and the relative tolerance must be between 0 and 1

api.spec_filter.zh-CN: 截止频率目前支持 lowpass / highpass；其他滤波器需要专用验收设置
api.spec_filter.en: Cutoff currently supports low-pass and high-pass. Other filters need a dedicated check.

api.spec_skip.zh-CN: 去暂态比例必须在 0–0.95 之间
api.spec_skip.en: The settling skip must be between 0 and 0.95

api.spec_upper.zh-CN: 验收上限必须有限且不小于下限
api.spec_upper.en: The upper limit must be finite and at least the lower limit

api.spec_comp.zh-CN: 元件不存在、重复或不是字面量数值
api.spec_comp.en: The part is missing, duplicated, or not a literal value

api.spec_nonfinite.en: The measurement is not a finite value

api.netlist_big_hint.zh-CN: 元件数量异常，请检查画布
api.netlist_big_hint.en: Unusual part count. Check the canvas.

api.safety_hint.zh-CN: 画板生成的网表不应包含外部命令
api.safety_hint.en: A canvas netlist should not contain external commands

api.check_hint.zh-CN: 按错误提示回到画布连线；每个元件引脚都要接到网络，且电路必须有接地
api.check_hint.en: Use the messages above. Every pin needs a net, and the circuit needs a ground.

api.no_wave.zh-CN: 仿真通过但没有产出波形数据
api.no_wave.en: Simulation finished but produced no waveform

api.no_wave_hint.zh-CN: 检查仿真类型与分析参数是否匹配（如交流扫描需要 AC 源）
api.no_wave_hint.en: Check that the analysis matches the sources (an AC sweep needs an AC source)

api.evidence_hint.zh-CN: 请检查输出数据后重新仿真
api.evidence_hint.en: Check the output data and simulate again

api.sim_no_text.zh-CN: 仿真失败且无报错文本
api.sim_no_text.en: Simulation failed with no error text

api.target_hint.zh-CN: 按验收明细调整电路后重新仿真
api.target_hint.en: Adjust the circuit using the acceptance details, then simulate again

api.hint.singular.zh-CN: 存在与地没有直流通路的节点：检查每个节点是否经元件连到地（电容隔直的节点加大电阻接地）
api.hint.singular.en: A node has no DC path to ground. Connect it through a part, or add a large resistor to ground across a coupling capacitor.

api.hint.timestep.zh-CN: 瞬态步长失败：常见于开关突变或增益过大引起的振荡发散，先减小仿真时长或检查反馈极性
api.hint.timestep.en: Transient step failed. Often a switching edge or too much gain. Shorten the run or check feedback polarity.

api.hint.model.zh-CN: 元件缺少模型：删除后重新放置该元件（画板会自动补教学模型）
api.hint.model.en: A part has no model. Delete it and place it again so the canvas can add a teaching model.

api.hint.converge.zh-CN: 直流工作点不收敛：常见原因是正反馈或电源直接短路，检查连线
api.hint.converge.en: DC operating point did not converge. Check for positive feedback or a shorted source.

api.hint.generic.zh-CN: 回到画布检查连线与元件值，报错原文见上方
api.hint.generic.en: Check wiring and values on the canvas. The original message is above.

api.evidence_incomplete.zh-CN: 该次仿真没有完整证据，暂时不能解读
api.evidence_incomplete.en: That simulation has no complete evidence, so it cannot be explained yet

api.no_verified.zh-CN: 本项目还没有验证通过的电路——先点「仿真」再解读
api.no_verified.en: This project has no verified circuit yet. Simulate first, then ask for notes.

api.chat_stale.zh-CN: 项目已更新，请重新载入后发送
api.chat_stale.en: The project changed. Reload it, then send again.

api.no_netlist.zh-CN: 当前画布尚未生成可用网表，请先仿真或从画布发送 AI 修改
api.no_netlist.en: The canvas has no usable netlist yet. Simulate, or ask AI to edit it from the canvas.

api.whatif_missing.zh-CN: 网表里没有可扫描的元件 '{name}'（只支持 R/C/L 与直流源）
api.whatif_missing.en: No scannable part '{name}' in the netlist (only R, C, L, and DC sources)

api.whatif_value.zh-CN: 扫描值必须是单个 SPICE 数值，如 1k、47n；不能包含表达式或命令
api.whatif_value.en: Each sweep value must be one SPICE number, such as 1k or 47n — no expressions or commands

api.whatif_note.zh-CN: 瞬态去除前20%时间暂态；扫描基于固定电路版本。候选方案应用前需确认。
api.whatif_note.en: The first 20% of each transient is discarded. The sweep uses a fixed circuit version. Confirm before applying a candidate.

api.interpret_down.zh-CN: AI 解读暂时不可用，仿真证据已保留：{detail}
api.interpret_down.en: AI interpretation is temporarily unavailable; the simulation evidence was kept: {detail}

api.cmp_note.zh-CN: 比较的是各版本已保存的证据；没有重新统一输入、负载与测量工况，请同时核对各版本验收条件。
api.cmp_note.en: This compares saved evidence. Inputs, loads, and setups were not rerun together — check each version's targets.

api.wave_note.zh-CN: 交互图为波形预览；验收指标使用全部原始数据计算。
api.wave_note.en: The interactive plot is a preview. Acceptance uses the full raw data.

api.wave_multi.zh-CN: raw 文件含 {n} 个 plot，已取最后一个（{name}）
api.wave_multi.en: The raw file has {n} plots. Using the last one ({name}).

api.pcb_no_circuit.zh-CN: 项目里还没有已验证的电路——先在画布或对话里完成一次仿真
api.pcb_no_circuit.en: This project has no verified circuit yet. Simulate on the canvas or in chat first.

api.pcb_ports.en: ports must be an array of at most 16 items

api.pcb_moves.zh-CN: moves 须为非空对象（≤64 项）
api.pcb_moves.en: moves must be a non-empty object with at most 64 items

api.pcb_xy.zh-CN: {ref} 的 x/y/rot 非法（毫米/度）
api.pcb_xy.en: {ref} has an invalid x, y, or rotation (mm / degrees)

api.pcb_archive_missing.zh-CN: 源任务的网表归档缺失
api.pcb_archive_missing.en: The source netlist archive is missing

api.pcb_tools.zh-CN: PCB 工具不全，无法重布线
api.pcb_tools.en: PCB tools are incomplete, so it cannot reroute

api.pcb_moved.zh-CN: 板文件缺失（工作区被移动或清理）
api.pcb_moved.en: Board file is missing (the workspace was moved or cleaned)

api.pcb_parse.en: Could not parse the board file

api.pcb_export_status.zh-CN: 仅检查通过的版本可导出制板包
api.pcb_export_status.en: Only a checked version can be exported

api.pcb_export_current.zh-CN: 该版本不是当前采用的板（导出须从当前版本冻结）
api.pcb_export_current.en: This is not the current board. Export freezes the current version.

api.pcb_fab_missing.zh-CN: 制板产物目录缺失（工作区被移动或清理）
api.pcb_fab_missing.en: Fab output is missing (the workspace was moved or cleaned)

api.pcb_hash.zh-CN: 板文件已被修改（与检查时哈希不符）：请在 KiCad 修改后执行回导再检查并重新导出
api.pcb_hash.en: The board file changed since it was checked. Re-import from KiCad, check again, then export.

api.pcb_incomplete.zh-CN: 制板产物不完整（缺 {missing}），目录现有 {n} 个文件
api.pcb_incomplete.en: Fab output is incomplete (missing {missing}). The folder has {n} files.

api.pcb_history.zh-CN: 源电路已变化：该制板包对应旧电路。如需导出历史版本请带 history=true（将明确标记为历史产物）
api.pcb_history.en: The source circuit changed, so this package matches an older circuit. Pass history=true to export it as a historical package.

api.kicad_hint.zh-CN: 设 VOLTPROOF_KICAD=<KiCad 根目录>（bin/ 含 kicad-cli.exe 与 python.exe）或安装 KiCad 10.x
api.kicad_hint.en: Set VOLTPROOF_KICAD to the KiCad root (bin/ needs kicad-cli and python) or install KiCad 10.x

api.free_hint.zh-CN: 设 VOLTPROOF_FREEROUTING=<freerouting-*.jar>；须用 JVM JAR（v2.5.0 原生 CLI 有已知缺陷）
api.free_hint.en: Set VOLTPROOF_FREEROUTING to freerouting-*.jar. Use the JVM JAR (the v2.5.0 native CLI has known bugs).

api.java_hint.zh-CN: 安装 Java 21+（JVM JAR 依赖）
api.java_hint.en: Install Java 21+ (required by the JVM JAR)

api.pcb_status.zh-CN: 候选状态为 {status}，仅检查通过的版本可被采用
api.pcb_status.en: Candidate status is {status}. Only a checked version can be adopted.

api.pcb_source.zh-CN: 无法确认源电路（{msg}）——请先在画布完成验证再采用
api.pcb_source.en: Could not confirm the source circuit ({msg}). Verify it on the canvas before adopting.

api.pcb_stale_adopt.zh-CN: 源电路电气内容已变化：该候选是旧电路的板，不可采用为当前电路的制板结果（可导出为历史版本）
api.pcb_stale_adopt.en: The source circuit changed. This candidate is an older board and cannot be adopted as the current one (you can still export it as history).

api.pcb_pointer.zh-CN: 当前板指针已被其他操作更新，请重新载入后再采用
api.pcb_pointer.en: The current board pointer was updated elsewhere. Reload, then adopt.

api.pcb_stale_none.zh-CN: 尚未采用任何 PCB 版本
api.pcb_stale_none.en: No PCB version has been adopted yet

api.pcb_stale_file.zh-CN: 当前版本记录文件缺失（被移动/删除）
api.pcb_stale_file.en: The current version record is missing (moved or deleted)

api.pcb_stale_hash.zh-CN: 源电路电气内容已变化——旧板仍是有效历史版本，但不可冒充当前电路的制板结果
api.pcb_stale_hash.en: The source circuit changed. The old board is still valid history, but it is not the current circuit's board.

api.block.zero.zh-CN: 0V 电压源通常作电流检测用：不是实物器件，也不能未经验证直接删除；请改用测试点/串联电阻取样并重新仿真（PCB 方案 §4.2）
api.block.zero.en: A 0 V source is usually a current sense, not a physical part, and it should not be deleted without a new simulation. Use a test point or a series resistor, then simulate again.

api.block.X.zh-CN: 子电路（含理想运放）不能直接变成实物 IC：请替换为具体型号（如 LM358，器件库已收参考条目）并补供电引脚与去耦，形成新的电路候选重新仿真验证后再映射（PCB 方案 §4.2）
api.block.X.en: A subcircuit (including an ideal op-amp) cannot become a physical IC. Replace it with a real part such as LM358, add supply pins and decoupling, then simulate the new candidate before mapping.

api.block.M.zh-CN: MOSFET 尚无审校器件条目（首批库只覆盖双极性三极管）
api.block.M.en: No curated MOSFET yet (the first library covers bipolar transistors only)

api.block.I.zh-CN: 电流源不是实物器件，也不能未经验证直接删除：请改为端子激励（外部电流注入）或经诺顿等效改成电压源+电阻，形成新电路候选重新仿真验证（PCB 方案 §4.2）
api.block.I.en: A current source is not a physical part and should not be deleted without a new simulation. Use a port stimulus, or a Norton equivalent (voltage source plus resistor), then simulate again.

api.block.K.zh-CN: 互感（K 语句）无独立封装，需展开为具体电感后映射
api.block.K.en: A mutual inductor (K) has no footprint. Expand it into real inductors before mapping.

api.block.F.en: A CCCS has no physical part

api.block.H.en: A CCVS has no physical part

api.block.E.en: A VCVS has no physical part

api.block.G.en: A VCCS has no physical part

api.block.B.zh-CN: 行为源（BSIM 行为级）无实物对应
api.block.B.en: A behavioral source has no physical part

api.block.T.en: A transmission line has no physical part

api.block.O.en: A lossy line has no physical part

api.block.ports.zh-CN: 激励源的网络未声明外部端子（ports）——信号源不是实物器件，必须经端子/连接器进出板子（PCB 方案 §4.2）
api.block.ports.en: A source net is not declared as a port. Sources are not physical parts; they must enter the board through a connector.

api.block.pins.zh-CN: 网表引脚数 {nets} ≠ 实物 {part} 的 {pins} 脚（引脚序不齐不可猜）
api.block.pins.en: Netlist has {nets} pins but {part} has {pins}. Pin order is not guessed.

api.block.entry_alt.zh-CN: 类型 {kind} 在 {mount} 安装方式下无审校条目（{kind} 无 {mount} 条目，可换安装方式
api.block.entry_alt.en: No curated {mount} entry for {kind} (no {mount} entry; try the other mount)

api.block.entry_none.zh-CN: 类型 {kind} 在 {mount} 安装方式下无审校条目（{kind} 无 {mount} 条目）

api.block.value.zh-CN: {kind} 型号/值 {value} 未匹配审校条目（不按类别猜测脚位）
api.block.value.en: No curated entry for {kind} value {value}. Pinout is not guessed from the category.

api.block.polar.zh-CN: 有极性：装配前人工复核丝印/极性标记
api.block.polar.en: Polarized: check the silkscreen and polarity before assembly

api.block.teach.zh-CN: 教学模型→实物型号映射：额定参数须按实物核对
api.block.teach.en: Teaching model mapped to a real part: check the ratings against the physical device

api.check.mega.zh-CN: 第 {lineno} 行：'{tok}' 的 M 会按毫处理——兆必须写 Meg 或 1000k
api.check.mega.en: Line {lineno}: '{tok}' — M means milli. Write Meg or 1000k for mega.

api.check.zero.zh-CN: 第 {lineno} 行：{kind} 元件值为 0，通常是笔误（0Ω/0F 无意义）
api.check.zero.en: Line {lineno}: {kind} value is 0, which is usually a typo

api.check.model_name.zh-CN: 第 {lineno} 行：{kind} 元件没有写模型名（应引用 .model 定义）
api.check.model_name.en: Line {lineno}: {kind} has no model name (it should reference a .model)

api.check.cider.zh-CN: 模型 '{name}' 的类型 {kind} 是 CIDER 数值器件模型，当前 ngspice 构建不支持（实测无任何输出直接挂死）——请改用标准 SPICE compact 模型（NPN/PNP/NMOS/D 等 + .model 参数）或等效子电路实现
api.check.cider.en: Model '{name}' type {kind} is a CIDER numerical model. This ngspice build does not support it and can hang. Use a compact SPICE model or an equivalent subcircuit.

api.check.ground.zh-CN: 网表没有参考地（节点 0）——所有电压/电流都失去参考。
api.check.ground.en: The netlist has no ground (node 0), so voltages and currents have no reference.

api.check.float.zh-CN: 节点 {n} 只被一个元件引用，疑似浮空（悬空节点会导致 singular matrix）。
api.check.float.en: Node {n} is used by only one part and looks floating (that leads to a singular matrix).

api.check.missing_model.zh-CN: 第 {lineno} 行：元件引用了模型 '{model}'，但没有对应的 .model 定义或 .include。
api.check.missing_model.en: Line {lineno}: model '{model}' is used but has no .model or .include.

api.safe.shell.zh-CN: 被禁止的系统命令：'{cmd}'（.control 内不允许执行系统命令）
api.safe.shell.en: Blocked system command: '{cmd}' (.control cannot run system commands)

api.safe.ext.zh-CN: 被禁止的外部程序调用：'{cmd}'（.control 内不允许启动 gnuplot/编辑器等外部程序）
api.safe.ext.en: Blocked external program: '{cmd}' (.control cannot launch gnuplot or an editor)

api.llm.400.zh-CN: 请求体格式错误（400），请对照返回的错误信息修正请求
api.llm.400.en: Bad request body (400). Use the returned error to fix the request.

api.llm.401.zh-CN: 认证失败（401）：API Key 无效，请检查 VOLTPROOF_API_KEY
api.llm.401.en: Authentication failed (401). Check the API key.

api.llm.402.zh-CN: 余额不足（402）：请前往 platform.deepseek.com 充值
api.llm.402.en: Insufficient balance (402). Top up the provider account.

api.llm.422.zh-CN: 参数错误（422）：请求参数不合法，请对照返回的错误信息修正
api.llm.422.en: Invalid parameters (422). Use the returned error to fix the request.

api.llm.429.zh-CN: 并发超限（429）：账号并发已达上限（flash 2500 / pro 500），请稍后重试
api.llm.429.en: Rate limit (429). The account is at its concurrency cap. Retry shortly.

api.llm.500.zh-CN: 服务器故障（500）：请稍后重试，持续出现请联系官方
api.llm.500.en: Provider error (500). Retry, and contact the provider if it continues.

api.llm.503.zh-CN: 服务器繁忙（503）：请稍后重试

api.llm.timeout.zh-CN: 请求超时（>{timeout}s，SDK 已自动重试 {retries} 次）；长思考任务可调大 VOLTPROOF_LLM_TIMEOUT
api.llm.timeout.en: Timed out (>{timeout}s, retried {retries} times). Raise VOLTPROOF_LLM_TIMEOUT for long reasoning tasks.

api.llm.connect.zh-CN: 无法连接 {url}（SDK 已自动重试 {retries} 次）：{msg}

api.llm.no_key.zh-CN: 缺少 API Key：请在前端页面「设置」里填写，或设置 VOLTPROOF_API_KEY 环境变量
api.llm.no_key.en: Missing API key. Set it under Model settings, or set VOLTPROOF_API_KEY.

api.llm.no_key_list.zh-CN: 缺少 API Key，无法查询模型列表
api.llm.no_key_list.en: Missing API key, so the model list cannot be fetched

api.llm.json_empty.zh-CN: JSON 模式连续返回空 content（官方已知问题），请调整 prompt 重试
api.llm.json_empty.en: JSON mode returned empty content twice. Adjust the prompt and retry.

api.llm.truncated.zh-CN: JSON 输出被 max_tokens 截断（finish_reason=length），请调大 max_tokens 或精简输出要求
api.llm.truncated.en: JSON output was truncated by max_tokens (finish_reason=length). Raise max_tokens or ask for less.

api.llm.json_bad.zh-CN: JSON 解析失败，前 200 字符：{text}
api.llm.json_bad.en: Could not parse JSON. First 200 characters: {text}

api.llm.scheme.zh-CN: Base URL 只允许 http/https 协议：{url}
api.llm.scheme.en: Base URL must use http or https: {url}

api.llm.loop.zh-CN: 不允许 localhost 供应商地址；本机模型服务（Ollama/LM Studio）请设置 VOLTPROOF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_LLM=1
api.llm.loop.en: Localhost providers are blocked. For a local model server (Ollama/LM Studio), set VOLTPROOF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_LLM=1.

api.llm.dns.zh-CN: 无法解析供应商主机名：{host}
api.llm.dns.en: Could not resolve the provider host: {host}

api.llm.private.zh-CN: 供应商主机 {host} 解析到内网/保留地址 {ip}，已拒绝；本机模型服务请设置 VOLTPROOF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_LLM=1
api.llm.private.en: Provider host {host} resolved to a private address {ip} and was refused. For a local model server, set VOLTPROOF_ALLOW_PRIVATE_LLM=1.

api.guard.zh-CN: 数字逻辑/RTL 需求，已前置拒绝（未调用生成与仿真）
api.guard.en: Digital / RTL request, rejected up front (no generation or simulation)

api.guard.text.zh-CN:
这个需求属于数字逻辑设计（Verilog / RTL）范畴，超出了 VoltProof 的能力范围。
VoltProof 做的是模拟电路：自然语言描述电路需求 → 生成 SPICE 网表 → ngspice 仿真验证，输出波形、实测指标与原理图。
建议：Verilog 实现请使用数字设计工具链（iverilog / Verilator 等）；如果题目背后有模拟部分（传感器信号调理、比较器阈值、滤波放大），欢迎改用电路语言描述，例如：设计一个温度报警电路，输入电压超过 2V 时输出翻转为高电平并带迟滞。
api.guard.text.en:
This request is digital logic (Verilog / RTL), which is outside VoltProof.
VoltProof is for analog circuits: a description becomes a SPICE netlist, ngspice simulates it, and you get a waveform, measurements, and a schematic.
Use a digital toolchain such as iverilog or Verilator for Verilog. If there is an analog part (sensor conditioning, a comparator threshold, filtering), describe that instead — for example, a temperature alarm that goes high, with hysteresis, when the input exceeds 2 V.

api.regen.zh-CN: 连续修复失败，换一种电路架构重新生成
api.regen.en: Repeated repairs failed. Trying another topology.

api.note.llm.zh-CN: 回喂差距，LLM 调参重跑
api.note.llm.en: Feeding the gap back to the model

api.measure.metric.zh-CN: 尚未支持 {metric} 的确定性验收，请补充专用测量设置
api.measure.metric.en: No deterministic check for {metric} yet. Add a dedicated measurement.

api.measure.out.zh-CN: 输出节点 {node} 缺失或不唯一，请明确选择节点并写入 raw
api.measure.out.en: Output node {node} is missing or ambiguous. Name it explicitly and write it to the raw file.

api.measure.empty.en: Waveform data is empty or invalid

api.measure.ac_stat.zh-CN: 电压统计和纹波需要工作点或瞬态分析，不能对扫频幅值计算
api.measure.ac_stat.en: Voltage statistics and ripple need an operating point or a transient, not an AC magnitude sweep

api.measure.ripple.zh-CN: 纹波需要稳态瞬态波形
api.measure.ripple.en: Ripple needs a settled transient waveform

api.measure.freq.zh-CN: 主频/失真需要瞬态波形
api.measure.freq.en: Fundamental and distortion need a transient waveform

api.measure.period.zh-CN: 观测时长不足或没有可测周期信号
api.measure.period.en: The run is too short, or there is no measurable periodic signal

api.measure.in.zh-CN: 缺少输入 {node}，无法计算传递函数
api.measure.in.en: Input {node} is missing, so the transfer function cannot be computed

api.measure.tf.zh-CN: 输入幅值为零或传递函数无效
api.measure.tf.en: Input amplitude is zero, or the transfer function is invalid

api.measure.phase.zh-CN: 有符号增益需要输入与输出的相位数据
api.measure.phase.en: Signed gain needs input and output phase

api.measure.span.zh-CN: 扫频范围不足以确定通带和截止点
api.measure.span.en: The sweep does not cover enough range to find the passband and cutoff

api.measure.flat.zh-CN: 扫频尚未覆盖平坦通带，请扩大频率范围
api.measure.flat.en: The sweep does not cover a flat passband. Widen the frequency range.

api.measure.cross.zh-CN: 扫频范围没有唯一的 −3 dB 交点，请调整范围或选择滤波类型
api.measure.cross.en: The sweep has no unique −3 dB crossing. Adjust the range or the filter type.

api.measure.ac.zh-CN: 截止频率需要 AC 扫描数据

api.measure.const.zh-CN: 输入恒定，无法测量交流增益
api.measure.const.en: The input is constant, so AC gain cannot be measured

report.rejected.zh-CN: 超出能力范围（前置拒绝，未消耗生成与仿真）
report.rejected.en: Out of scope (rejected up front; no generation or simulation was run)

report.legacy.zh-CN: 历史结果，目标验收状态未知

report.elapsed.zh-CN: · 耗时 {s}s · 修复环 {n} 轮
